name: AetherCode
intro: AetherCode v1收录456道来自OI与ICPC系列顶级竞赛的题目，其中2024年400题、2025年1至5月56题。它以超过3万份人类正确与错误提交验证测试套件，并结合Generator-Validator自动构造、67名竞赛编程专家定向补充及顶尖团队人工审计，在收集的解答集上达到100% TPR与100% TNR。
build_method: 顶级竞赛题整理, 自动测试生成, 67名专家定向补充, 人工质量审计
build_method_en: Premier-contest curation, automatic test generation, targeted cases from 67 experts, manual quality audit
intro_en: AetherCode v1 contains 456 problems from premier OI- and ICPC-series competitions: 400 from 2024 and 56 from January-May 2025. It validates test suites against more than 30,000 correct and incorrect human submissions, combining Generator-Validator construction, targeted cases from 67 competitive-programming experts, and an elite manual audit to reach 100% TPR and 100% TNR on the collected solution set.

drawio_review_note: PASS review aligned with arXiv:2508.16402v1 §§2.1–2.4 and §3. The workflow preserves premier OI/ICPC/CCPC collection; PDF-to-proofread Markdown and LaTeX conversion; submission screening with more than 30,000 human solutions and at least five correct plus twenty incorrect submissions per problem; official tests when available or Generator-Validator construction; targeted cases from 67 experts; expert audit and checker review; the 456-problem difficulty split of 159 easy, 145 medium, 132 hard, and 20 extreme; and four-sample Pass@1/2/4 evaluation.
